messages: Customer: Hello, my postpaid invoice INV-2026-0918734 for September is 289.50 SAR. It is usually around 200. Can you explain what the extra charges are?
Agent: Thank you for reaching out. The increase comes from a one-time device installment fee added this cycle. Is there anything else I can help with?
Customer: I tried to pay my mobile bill of 145 SAR using my Mada card but the app said 'Transaction declined'. I checked my bank app and nothing was deducted. Account number 5501234567.
Agent: Thanks for confirming no amount was deducted. Please try again in 30 minutes or use a different card; your issuer may have blocked online payments.
Customer: I can't log into my wallet. The OTP never arrives on my phone. My account ID is WAL-778812.
Agent: I've reset the OTP channel on account WAL-778812. Please try logging in again and let me know if the code arrives.
Customer: How do I add a second credit card to my wallet so I can choose which one to use for bill payments?
Customer: I ordered a new SIM card for delivery a week ago, order ORD-55120934, and it still hasn't arrived. Tracking says 'in transit' since Sunday.
Agent: I'm sorry for the delay. I've escalated ORD-55120934 to the courier; you should receive it within 2 working days.
Customer: paid my bill 230 sr yesterday money gone frm my acc but app still says bill unpaid??
Customer: ref TXN88213409 pls fix asap
Customer: hi i cancled my order 7712045 b4 shipping want my 99 sar back how long it takes
Customer: wallet app not opening since morning wallah nothing works
Customer: cant pay anything cant even login, ur website also down??
Agent: We are aware of a full outage affecting the wallet app and web portal. Our teams are working on it.
Customer: wat is 'content svc' 12 SAR on my invoice?? not complainin just wanna knw lol
Customer: Hi, I paid my electricity bill through your wallet and I was charged twice. 312.00 SAR two times in the same minute.
Agent: Hello! Sorry to hear that. Could you share the transaction reference?
Customer: Sure, TXN-6630918. The second one probably has a different number but I only see this one in the app.
Agent: Thank you. Could you also confirm the amount?
Customer: As I said, 312.00 SAR, taken twice. My bank statement shows both. Please refund the extra one, I already told the first agent this yesterday.
Agent: Understood, I've raised a refund for the duplicate 312.00 SAR charge on TXN-6630918. It will be processed within 5 to 7 working days. Have a good evening!
Customer: Salam alaikum, hope you're doing well.
Agent: Wa alaikum assalam! Doing great, how can I help today?
Customer: My new prepaid card was supposed to arrive last Thursday, order ORD-90477215. Still nothing.
Agent: Let me check... The courier attempted delivery but couldn't reach you by phone.
Customer: Nobody called me, my phone was on all day. Order ORD-90477215, please check again, it's a prepaid card.
Agent: I've rescheduled delivery for tomorrow between 9 AM and 1 PM, inshallah it will reach you. Anything else?
Customer: Hi, I've been trying to reset my password for an hour.
Agent: Hi there! Sorry about that. What happens when you try?
Customer: I get the reset email, click it, set a new password, and then it says 'link expired' and sends me back to the start.
Agent: Could you try again using a private browser window?
Customer: Tried that. Same thing. Link expired. Every time.
Agent: Thanks for your patience. I've opened case CS-2026-118804 for our technical team and they will reset it manually within 24 hours. Have a great day!

Customer: Two things. My bill this month looks high, 410 SAR, I'll check that later. The real problem is I can't pay it at all, my card was declined 3 times and my bank shows nothing taken. Due date is tomorrow, account 5507788231.
Agent: I see no successful or pending payment on account 5507788231. The decline came from your card issuer. Would you like to try Apple Pay or SADAD instead?
Customer: My phone case order ORD-33018842 arrived two weeks late and the app tracking was wrong the whole time. Honestly I don't need it anymore. I want my 79 SAR back.
Agent: I'm sorry about the delay. Since the item was delivered, a refund requires returning it unused. Shall I arrange a pickup?
Customer: I couldn't log in this morning, it said my password was wrong. After resetting it I see a transfer of 1,500 SAR from my wallet to someone I don't know. I never made this.
Agent: I've frozen your wallet immediately. The transfer reference is TRF-20261029-55831. We are opening a fraud investigation.
Customer: My home fiber internet has been completely dead since yesterday afternoon, all lights red on the router. Also, will I still be billed for these days? Account 8100452290.
Agent: There is a confirmed outage in your area affecting account 8100452290. Engineers are on site. Compensation for downtime will be reviewed once service is restored.
Customer: I just got an SMS that my wallet card was charged 750.00 SAR at an online store I have never heard of. I am at home and my card is with me. Authorization number AUTH-4471902.
Agent: Thank you for reporting this quickly. I've blocked the card and disputed authorization AUTH-4471902. A new card will be issued.
Customer: Ya akhi something is very wrong. My SIM suddenly lost signal and I'm getting emails about OTPs I never requested for my wallet.
Customer: Also someone called me yesterday claiming to be from your company asking for my verification code. I didn't give it.
Agent: This may be a SIM swap attempt. I've suspended the line and locked your wallet. Your case number is CASE-20261030-4471. Please visit a branch with your ID to restore the SIM.
Customer: My bill was 89 SAR but your auto-pay charged my card 890 SAR! Transaction TXN-7714025. I need the difference back now, I have rent due.
Agent: I can see the 890 SAR charge on TXN-7714025 against an 89 SAR invoice. I've escalated a refund of the excess as a priority.
Customer: I topped up my wallet with 500 SAR from my Al Rajhi account. The bank deducted it but my wallet balance is still 0. Top-up reference TOP-3390127.
Agent: I can see top-up TOP-3390127 is stuck in pending on our side. I've raised it with the payments team to credit or reverse within 24 hours.
Customer: Hi, I ordered a new SIM card for home delivery on Oct 24, order ORD-558214. Tracking still says 'preparing shipment'. When will it arrive?
Agent: Thanks for reaching out. Order ORD-558214 is queued at the Jeddah warehouse and should ship within 2 business days.
Customer: OK thanks, please send me the tracking link once it moves.
Customer: My October invoice INV-2026-10-4471 has a line called 'Roaming Pass Weekly' for 55 SAR. I did buy it for my Bahrain trip, I just want to know if it renews automatically.
Agent: It doesn't auto-renew unless you turn on auto-renewal in the app. The 55 SAR was a one-time charge.
Customer: I tried to buy the 99 SAR eSIM plan for my second line. My card got declined with error reference REF7730192. I checked my bank app and nothing was deducted. What should I do?
Agent: That decline usually means the 3-D Secure step wasn't completed. Please retry and approve the OTP from your bank.
Customer: I replaced my SIM yesterday after the old one got damaged, and now I can't log into the app. It says the OTP was sent but nothing arrives. Account number 1048823561.
Agent: After a SIM replacement, OTP delivery can take up to 24 hours to resync. I've reset the login on account 1048823561, please try again in an hour.
Customer: Alright, I'll try then.
Customer: Does the Galaxy S25 support two active eSIM profiles on your network at the same time? Thinking of buying one.
Agent: Yes, it supports two eSIM profiles, though only one can use data at a time.
Customer: hi i paid 35 for the 10gb esim data pack like 2 hrs ago money gone frm my acc but no pack nothing
Customer: txn TX88231 pls fix asap
Customer: no signal AT ALL since morning, sim says no service, restarted 5 times, wifes line same thing. whats going on??
Agent: We're seeing a network fault affecting parts of north Riyadh. Engineers are working on it now.
Customer: my iphone order 4471209 still not here its 6 days u said 2-3 days
Customer: courier not answering phone also
Customer: want refund for roaming pass 120 sar didnt even travel trip cancelled. ref RP-66012
Agent: The pass was never activated, so it's eligible. I've submitted the refund.
Customer: Good evening! Hope you're doing well. I have a question about my device installment.
Agent: Good evening, happy to help. What's the question?
Customer: This month I was charged 249 SAR twice for the same phone installment. Invoice INV-88412. Both show on my card statement.
Agent: Thank you. Could you confirm the last 4 digits of the card?
Customer: 6610. Again, two charges of 249 SAR on the same day, invoice INV-88412. I need one of them refunded please.
Agent: Confirmed, there's a duplicate capture. I've raised a refund for the second 249 SAR, it takes 5-7 business days. Have a nice weekend!
Customer: Hello, I lost my phone last week and ordered a replacement SIM, order ORD-772190.
Agent: Sorry to hear that! I can see the order. Did you also block the old SIM?
Customer: Yes, blocked it the same day. The order was supposed to arrive Sunday.
Agent: The courier shows a delay at the Buraydah hub due to high volume. Expected tomorrow.
Customer: Any update? It's Wednesday now and still nothing for ORD-772190.
Customer: Any update please? I really need my number back for work.
Customer: Hi, I'm in Istanbul for a conference, lovely city by the way!
Agent: Welcome! Hope the trip is going well. How can I help?
Customer: Roaming is active on subscription SUB-4410937 but I have zero service. No calls, no SMS, no data since I landed yesterday.
Agent: Have you tried selecting a network manually?
Customer: Yes, tried both local networks manually. Still no service at all on SUB-4410937.
Customer: Still nothing. No service at all. I can't reach my family.
Customer: My 5G home router order ORD-903311 was supposed to arrive 4 days ago and it still hasn't shipped. Also, when will my first bill be issued and will it be prorated?
Agent: Let me check the shipment first, then I'll explain the billing cycle.

Customer: I can't log into the app since this morning, the password reset link doesn't work. And my bank shows an 89 SAR charge from you for a 'Roaming Day Pass' I never bought, transaction TXN-5502874. I haven't left Riyadh.
Agent: I'll secure your account first and open a dispute for TXN-5502874.

Customer: Trying to buy the 149 SAR GCC roaming pack before my Dubai trip but payment keeps getting declined, error code DCL-301557, tried two cards. Nothing was deducted. Also, how much is a call to Saudi from the UAE without the pack?
Agent: I'll look into the decline first, then share the pay-as-you-go roaming rates.
Customer: The Pixel 9 I ordered (ORD-610455, 3199 SAR) arrived two days late and the screen was cracked out of the box. I don't want a replacement, just my money back. Also the courier was rude.
Agent: Sorry about this. Please share photos of the device and the packaging so we can process it.
Customer: My line went dead last night, then this morning I got emails about three wallet transfers totalling 1500 SAR. I didn't make any of them. I think someone swapped my SIM.
Agent: I've frozen your wallet and SIM and opened fraud case CASE-2209871. Please visit a branch with your ID to reissue the SIM.

Customer: I got an SMS saying an eSIM was activated on a new device, plus an order for an iPhone on 24-month installment, order ORD-845120, first payment 2,899 SAR. I didn't order anything and my phone still has my SIM.
Agent: Blocking the eSIM profile and the order now. Please don't share any OTPs with anyone.

Customer: I paid 450 SAR for the Europe roaming package an hour before my flight, transaction TRX-77310482. The money is gone from my account but the package never activated and now I'm in Paris with no data or calls.
Agent: I can see the payment was captured but provisioning failed. Escalating this now.
Customer: I just got an email that my account password and registered email were changed. That wasn't me! Account 1093340718. I think someone is also trying to transfer my number.
Agent: I've locked account 1093340718 and reverted the email. Please verify your identity at a branch as soon as possible.
Customer: Hi, my fiber internet is completely down. No lights on the ONT except power, and none of my neighbours in the building have internet either. Account number 30418877.
Agent: Thank you. I can confirm an outage affecting fiber service in your area since 14:20. Engineers are on site.
Customer: Is there an estimate? I work from home.
Customer: I'm not receiving the OTP SMS when I try to log in to the app. Tried 4 times in the last hour.
Agent: Sorry about that. Can you confirm the mobile number registered on the account?
Customer: 0551234567. My account ID is MA-2209415.
Customer: Hello, does the Home Fiber 500 plan include a free router, and is fiber available in Al Rayyan district in Buraydah?
Customer: My October bill is SAR 412.50 but my plan is SAR 345. Invoice INV-2026-1033817. What are the extra charges?
Agent: The difference is roaming data used on 12 October during your trip to Bahrain. You can see the breakdown in the app under Bills > Details.
Customer: I cancelled my order for the Wi-Fi 6 mesh router before it shipped. Order ORD-778120. Please refund the SAR 349 I paid.
Agent: I can see the cancellation was accepted. The refund will be processed to your original card within 5-7 business days.
Customer: yalla why my card keep getting declined?? tried pay the bill 3 times 180 sr
Customer: wallah no money gone from bank tho, just says declined
Agent: Thanks. Declines with no deduction usually come from the bank side or 3D Secure. Please try again or use Apple Pay.
Customer: app dead. white screen since mrng cant do nothing
Customer: deleted n reinstalled same thing
Agent: We're aware of an issue preventing the app from loading for all users. Our team is working on it; the website is available meanwhile.
Customer: recharged 75 sar thru app, money cut from my bank but no balance on line!!
Customer: txn 88213490 pls check asap
Agent: I can see the payment was received but the top-up did not complete. Escalating now.
Customer: cant login says acount locked, too many tries. plz unlock
Customer: Assalamu alaikum. My fiber has been completely down since yesterday evening. Nothing works, no internet at all.
Agent: Wa alaikum assalam, sorry to hear that. I've opened case CS-2026-118842. Could you restart the router for me?
Customer: Already did, three times. Also my son was in the middle of his online exam, khalas he missed it. Anyway how long?
Customer: Hello? Still no internet. Case CS-2026-118842. It's been more than 20 hours now.
Agent: Apologies for the wait. There's a fiber cut on the main line in your district; repairs are in progress.
Customer: Okay, inshallah soon. Please send me an SMS when it's back. Thanks for your patience with me haha.
Customer: Hi, I ordered a 5G home router 9 days ago, order ORD-552019. Tracking still says 'preparing shipment'.
Agent: Hello! Thanks for reaching out. Let me check that for you.
Customer: Sure. By the way your new app design looks nice, much easier to find things.
Agent: Glad you like it! I see your order is waiting for stock at the Riyadh warehouse. It should ship within 2-3 days.
Customer: You said that last week too. Order ORD-552019, please, I really need it before the weekend.
Agent: Understood. I've flagged it for priority dispatch and you'll get an SMS with the courier details.
Customer: Hi, I was charged twice for my postpaid bill this month.
Agent: Sorry about that. Could you share the invoice number?
Customer: INV-2026-0947702. SAR 230 taken twice from my Mada card on the 3rd.
Customer: Hello?? Anyone there? Charged twice, SAR 230 x2.
Agent: Apologies for the delay. I confirm a duplicate payment on invoice INV-2026-0947702. I've requested a refund of the extra SAR 230.
Customer: Thank you. How long does that take? Have a good evening.
Customer: I got an SMS saying my account would be suspended, clicked the link and entered my username and password. Now I can't log in to the app, it says wrong password.
Customer: Also my internet is a bit slow today, not sure if related.
Agent: Thank you for telling us. That link was not from us. I've secured your account MA-3381206 and sent a reset link to your registered email.
Customer: My fiber was down from 18 to 22 October. It's working again now, but I paid SAR 299 for the month and lost 5 days. I want money back for those days.
Customer: Also, why does my latest bill show a 'late fee'? I always pay on time.
Agent: Thanks. I'll raise a compensation request for the outage days on account 30552901 and check the late fee separately.
Customer: I'm calling about the replacement router you promised. Order ORD-610447, it was supposed to arrive Tuesday and nothing yet.
Customer: My old router keeps dropping the connection every hour or so, it comes back after a minute.
Agent: I see the courier attempted delivery on Tuesday but couldn't reach you. I'll reschedule for tomorrow.
Customer: Tried to pay SAR 150 for my prepaid recharge, the app said 'payment declined'. But my bank app shows a pending SAR 150!
Customer: Also how do I add a second card to the app?

Agent: The pending amount is an authorization hold, reference AUTH-603318. Since the payment was declined it was not captured and your bank will release it within 3 days. You can add a card under Wallet > Payment methods.

Customer: There are 3 transactions in my wallet I didn't make, total SAR 1,200, all to an online gaming store. I got a weird SMS yesterday with a link pretending to be you but I didn't enter anything.
Agent: I've frozen your wallet immediately. The transactions are under reference WLT-90045127. A fraud case is being opened.
Customer: My SIM suddenly stopped working last night, 'no service' only on my phone. My wife's phone on the same network works fine.
Customer: This morning my bank shows a transfer of 4,500 riyals I never made! Wallah I didn't do this. I think someone took my number.
Agent: This looks like a possible SIM swap. I've blocked the new SIM issued on your line and opened fraud case FR-2026-07731. Please also call your bank to block the transfer.
Customer: I just got an email saying my account password and recovery email were changed. I didn't do that! Now I can't sign in.
Agent: I'm locking the account now and verifying your identity. Is your account number 30771584?
Customer: Yes, that's it. Please hurry, my card is saved in the app.
Customer: I received an SMS saying I won a prize from your company and must pay a delivery fee through a link. I didn't click it. Is this real?
Agent: That message is not from us, it's a phishing attempt. Thank you for reporting it; please delete it and never share any OTP.
Customer: Hi, I moved from Basic 4G to the 5G Plus plan on the 12th. My invoice INV-55821 shows 87.50 SAR this month. Can you explain how that number was calculated?
Agent: Sure, that amount includes a prorated portion of both plans for this billing cycle. I'll send you the full breakdown by SMS.
Customer: I tried to buy a 200 SAR gift card in the app and got 'card declined'. I checked my bank app and nothing was deducted. Order GC-20931.
Agent: Thanks for checking. Since no amount was captured, you can safely retry with the same or another card.
Customer: Great, I'll try my other card then.
Customer: I'm the admin on our business account BA-77140 and I got locked out after entering the wrong OTP a few times. How do I get back in?
Agent: The lock lifts automatically after 30 minutes, or I can reset it now after verifying your company CR number.
Customer: I ordered a physical gift card pack for our office on Oct 20, order ORD-448210. Tracking hasn't moved in 6 days.
Agent: I see the courier has a delay at the Riyadh hub. I've raised a follow-up and you should get an update within 48 hours.
Customer: Is it possible to gift a 3-month streaming add-on subscription to my brother's number, or does it have to be on my own line?
Agent: Yes, you can gift it to any active number on our network from the Gifts section in the app.

Customer: card is fine works everywhere else. nothing got deducted btw
Customer: SUB-90311
Customer: السلام عليكم ابي refund للـ gift card اللي اشتريتها بالغلط

Agent: وعليكم السلام، بما ان الكود ما تم استخدامه نقدر نرفع طلب استرجاع لك.

Customer: pls block it

Customer: err 503 everywhere fix asap

Agent: Hi! Happy to help. What seems to be the issue?
Customer: The 300 SAR left my account (transaction TXN-5520187) but I never got the code by SMS or email. Her birthday is tomorrow, she's turning 30, we're doing a small dinner lol
Customer: The 300 SAR left my account (transaction TXN-5520187) but I never got the code by SMS or email.

Customer: ok thank you, so I'll get the code or my money back? Sorry for the double message, my connection is bad.

Customer: غيرت الباقة لـ Business Pro امس وانخصم مني 129 ريال مرتين! reference REF-310077

Customer: Hi there, quick one (well, maybe not quick haha). We upgraded our company to the Business 50 plan last week.
Agent: Hi! Congrats on the upgrade. How can I help?
Customer: Thanks! Since the upgrade, two of my team members can't log in to the business portal, it says 'user not linked'. Account 1009457.
Agent: Could you confirm whether they were added before or after the plan change?
Customer: Before. Since the upgrade, two of my team members can't log in to the business portal, it says 'user not linked'. Account 1009457. Sorry, pasting again in case it got lost.
Customer: Also loving the new speeds by the way, the office is much happier 🙂
Customer: The app was pretty laggy this morning, took ages to load my bill, but it works now.
Customer: My actual question: I downgraded to the Lite plan on Oct 15 and invoice INV-60214 still shows the old price. When will the new 179 SAR price start applying?
Agent: Downgrades take effect from the next cycle, so 179 SAR will appear on your November invoice.

Customer: والمناسبة خلصت فما ابيها. ابي refund للـ 250 ريال كامل لو سمحت
Agent: نعتذر عن التأخير. بما ان الكود ما تم استخدامه نقدر نرفع طلب استرجاع.

Customer: But my bank app shows a pending 59.00 from you, authorization AUTH-662901. So did you take my money or not?
Agent: That's a temporary authorization hold from the declined attempt. It was not captured and your bank will release it within 3-5 business days.
Customer: OK, so nothing was actually charged. How do I retry the renewal?
Customer: One of our employees left the company two weeks ago. I need his access to our business account BA-30982 removed.
Customer: And more urgently, I just noticed a 1000 SAR gift card purchase made yesterday from his user. Nobody approved that.
Agent: I've suspended the user and flagged the transaction for our fraud team.

Agent: I'm locking the account now and escalating to our security team. Please don't share any OTPs you receive.
